content_sections.heading: About RGCB Project Technical Support III
content_sections.text: The Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (BRIC-RGCB) is a research institute located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, operating under the Department of Biotechnology (DBT). This recruitment is specifically for the ICMR Intramural Centre for Collaborative Research (CCR) to support research on Malaria and Host Factors.

content_sections.heading: RGCB Project Technical Support III at a Glance

rows.details: ICMR Intramural Centre for Collaborative Research (CCR)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualifications to be eligible for the Project Technical Support III position: Three years graduate in relevant subject field + three years of experience; OR PG in the field of life science/ molecular biology/ infectious disease biology. Desirable qualifications include a basic understanding of cell culture, experience and interest in microscopy, protein biochemistry, or structural biology, experience working in a BSL-2 laboratory, prior experience in infectious disease research or haematology, and the availability to travel to partnering institutions in the Northeast for field sample collection and research. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive a monthly emolument of ₹ 28,000 plus HRA. The appointment is initially for a period of one year or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The tenure is extendable based on performance evaluation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGCB Project Technical Support III
content_sections.text: Visit the official RGCB careers portal to access the online application form. Ensure all information provided is in the prescribed format; applications not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected. Candidates currently working in Government firms must send their applications through the proper channel. Submit the completed application form online by the deadline of 1 November 2026. If applying for multiple positions, submit separate application forms for each.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted for an online selection interview based on the eligibility criteria. The final selection of suitable candidates will be made based on their qualifications and performance during the selection interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support III post?
faq.answer: There are a total of two vacancies for the Project Technical Support III position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed applications is 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a three-year graduate degree in a relevant field with three years of experience, or a PG degree in life science, molecular biology, or infectious disease biology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 30 years as on 1 November 2026, with age relaxation provided as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, this is a temporary project position that is co-terminus with the end of the project and does not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB.

faq.question: Q6. How will the selection be conducted?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on shortlisting followed by an online selection interview.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any specific requirements for government employees?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates currently working in government firms must send their applications through the proper channel.
